contract.purpose: Turn owner judgments into trustworthy quality labels before movie dialogue can enter Meme Lab retrieval.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab turns one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.audience: The owner, reviewing a bounded local dataset before dialogue expansion.
contract.job: Judge whether each exact movie line is sendable, understandable without its scene, and strong enough to keep.
contract.thesis: Extend the approved Reference Desk review surface with one explicit dataset switch, a focused three-part quality decision, and a bias-safe calibration checkpoint.
contract.system: Preserve navy, white, cobalt, quiet semantic colors, compact status labels, serif source language, modest corners, and existing responsive behavior.
contract.signature: The exact movie line is treated as a source record with speaker, film, provenance, three independent quality judgments, and a model checkpoint that unlocks only after sufficient labels.
contract.risk: Three judgments can slow review, so every dimension uses one-tap choices, keyboard support, automatic advance, resumable progress, and a visible 50-label milestone.

projectCheck.command: npm test && npm run check && git diff --check

ownerFeedback.note: Preserve-mode extension of the owner-approved Reference Desk direction; no new visual direction was introduced.
